# The resident intelligence community

Fifteen permanent identities, one per durable organizational competency. Permanent identity is
*not* a unit of parallelism — massive temporary parallelism lives underneath these roles as
ephemeral workers that are created for one bounded problem and then released.

The names and coats make the organization legible. They do not create the competence.
Competence comes from model selection, context, the role contract, the tool envelope, memory,
and above all from the fact that nobody here grades their own work.

| Resident | Responsibility | District | Route | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Atlas](residents/atlas.md) | Chief executive agent · chief systems architect · chief of staff | Command Spire | `claude-opus-5` | Decomposition, routing, prioritization, resource allocation, re-planning on stall |
| [Verity](residents/verity.md) | Research director · investigative scientist | Observatory | `claude-opus-5` | Evidence and source standards; may reject a claim for insufficient sourcing |
| [Nova](residents/nova.md) | Chief product officer · strategist | Strategy Chamber | `claude-opus-5` | Product definition, scope and priority; may cut scope, may not cut a gate |
| [Sol](residents/sol.md) | Principal UX architect | Design Atelier | `claude-sonnet-5` | Flows, information architecture, usability structure |
| [Iris](residents/iris.md) | Creative director · visual systems | Design Atelier | `claude-sonnet-5` | Art direction and the visual system |
| [Kinetic](residents/kinetic.md) | Interaction and motion director | Motion Studio | `claude-sonnet-5` | Motion language, state transitions, response behaviour |
| [Rune](residents/rune.md) | Principal frontend engineer | Engineering Foundry | `claude-sonnet-5` | Client implementation |
| [Vector](residents/vector.md) | Principal systems / backend architect | Systems Foundry | `claude-opus-5` | Data models, APIs, infrastructure design |
| [Aegis](residents/aegis.md) | Chief security engineer | Security Citadel | `claude-opus-5` | Permissions, privacy, threat review; may block release unilaterally |
| [Argus](residents/argus.md) | Director of QA and evaluation | Verification Arena | `claude-sonnet-5` | Independent validation; a failed verdict is not appealable without new evidence |
| [Flux](residents/flux.md) | Performance specialist | Performance Lab | `claude-sonnet-5` | Latency, load and rendering budgets; may block release on a budget breach |
| [Mercy](residents/mercy.md) | Accessibility and human-factors lead | Civic Hall | `claude-sonnet-5` | Inclusive usability; may block release on a conformance failure |
| [Nyx](residents/nyx.md) | Red-team critic · professional skeptic | Red Team Annex | `claude-opus-5` | Break assumptions; findings cannot be closed by the author of the artifact |
| [Mnemos](residents/mnemos.md) | Knowledge and memory architect | Great Archive | `claude-haiku-4-5` | Provenance and durable context; may refuse to archive an unsourced claim |
| [Pax](residents/pax.md) | Release governor | Release Tower | `claude-opus-5` | Final release authority; may only approve against a complete evidence manifest |

## Domain ownership

Exactly one resident owns each domain. Contribution is plural; accountability is singular.

- `orchestration` → **atlas**
- `research` → **verity**
- `product` → **nova**
- `ux` → **sol**
- `visual` → **iris**
- `motion` → **kinetic**
- `frontend` → **rune**
- `backend` → **vector**
- `security` → **aegis**
- `quality` → **argus**
- `performance` → **flux**
- `accessibility` → **mercy**
- `adversarial` → **nyx**
- `knowledge` → **mnemos**
- `release` → **pax**

## The Adversarial Quality Council

- **argus** — Director of QA and evaluation
- **nyx** — Red-team critic · professional skeptic
- **aegis** — Chief security engineer
- **mercy** — Accessibility and human-factors lead
- **flux** — Performance specialist

Any one of them can block a release on their own verdict. None of them can approve one; that
is Pax's alone, and only against a complete evidence manifest.

## Growing the roster

New residents are not added by editing this file. A capability gap is *measured* from what a
run actually cost, a genome is drafted, and the candidate is refused four times over before it
is admitted — see [`../docs/GENESIS.md`](../docs/GENESIS.md) and
[`genomes/`](genomes/) for a worked example.
